newsitem.title: USA: Ann Daly named head of DreamWorks Animation.
newsitem.headline: Ann Daly named head of DreamWorks Animation.

text.p: DreamWorks SKG Thursday named former Walt Disney Co executive Ann Daly to the post of head of DreamWorks SKG's Feature Animation division.
In a statement, DreamWorks said Daly's position is effective in July. As head of feature animation she will work in partnership with Ron Rocha.

As president of Disney's Buena Vista Home Video, a position she left this past spring, Daly was responsible for marketing, sales, distribution, production and all other areas of the company's operation.
